tests.name: Msiexec.exe - Execute the DllRegisterServer function of a DLL
tests.description: Loads a DLL into msiexec.exe and calls its DllRegisterServer function. Note: the DLL included in the "bin" folder is only built for 64-bit, so this won't work on a 32-bit OS.

tests.name: Msiexec.exe - Execute Remote MSI file
tests.description: Execute arbitrary MSI file retrieved remotely. Less commonly seen in application installation, commonly seen in malware execution. The MSI executes a built-in JScript payload that launches powershell.exe.
